display_goal: Call the pharmacy on behalf of a patient looking for medication. Identify yourself immediately as an automated assistant and keep the call brief and polite. Ask whether they currently have amoxicillin 500mg in stock; the patient needs 21 capsules. Do not place an order or commit to anything on the patient's behalf. Capture the structured result using exactly these key names: in_stock (yes, no, partial, or unknown; use partial if they have some but fewer than 21 capsules), form_available (brand, generic, both, or unknown), quantity_available (integer units they have), unit_price (number, price per unit), currency (three-letter currency code), requires_prescription (yes, no, or unknown), can_hold (yes, no, or unknown), hold_duration_hours (number of hours they will hold it), alternative_suggested (any alternative or other branch they mention), and pharmacist_notes (anything else useful, one short sentence). If they do not have it, still ask about alternatives or another branch. Thank them and end the call. If nobody answers, report that the pharmacy could not be reached and do not treat that as a successful stock check.

next_step.instruction: The call result is still in progress or being finalized. Poll get_call_run again for this run; do not call plan_call or run_call again.
